key.name: display-mode
key.description: Where to render the effect: only on wallpaper background or as full-screen overlay.

key.name: active
key.description: Whether the effect is currently active (toggled on).

key.name: effect-type
key.description: Select the weather effect: snow or rain.

key.name: show-in-quick-settings
key.description: Show the weather effect toggle button and icon in the Quick Settings panel.

key.name: show-panel-icon
key.description: Show the weather icon in the top panel while keeping the Quick Settings tile available.

key.name: pause-on-fullscreen
key.description: When enabled and in Screen display mode, pause animation on monitors that have a fullscreen window.

key.name: particle-count
key.description: Number of particles shown on each monitor.

key.name: particle-size
key.description: Size of falling particles in pixels (4 to 32).

key.name: snow-default-particle-count
key.description: Number of default-shape snow particles shown on each monitor.

key.name: snow-default-particle-size
key.description: Size in pixels of default-shape snow particles.

key.name: snow-emoji-particle-count
key.description: Number of emoji snow particles shown on each monitor.

key.name: snow-emoji-particle-size
key.description: Font size in pixels of emoji snow particles.

key.name: rain-default-particle-count
key.description: Number of default-shape rain particles shown on each monitor.

key.name: rain-default-particle-size
key.description: Size in pixels used to dimension default-shape rain particles.

key.name: rain-emoji-particle-count
key.description: Number of emoji rain particles shown on each monitor.

key.name: rain-emoji-particle-size
key.description: Font size in pixels of emoji rain particles.

key.name: particle-profile-migration-version
key.description: Internal version marker for one-time particle-profile settings migration.

key.name: speed
key.description: 0=ultra-slow, 1=slow, 2=medium, 3=fast

key.name: snow-color
key.description: Color of snow particles: white, light blue, or silver.

key.name: rain-color
key.description: Color of rain particles: gray or dark blue.

key.name: snow-emoji
key.description: Custom emoji for snow particles (e.g., ❄, ❅, ❆). Leave empty for default circular shape.

key.name: rain-emoji
key.description: Custom emoji for rain particles (e.g., 🌢). Leave empty for default rectangular shape.
